problem_summary: 8 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Sampangiram Nagar between January 2019 and July 2022, spanning 4 calendar year(s). 50% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 40 pothole complaints.
33 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹68.1 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (exact_name join).
Ward recorded 48 road crashes in 2024, of which 6 were fatal.

hypotheses: HYPOTHESIS (unverified): Road work contracts exist in this ward, yet 50% of complaints remain unresolved. This may indicate that repairs were incomplete, inadequate, or that the work was performed in different road segments. Independent verification required.
agency_attribution_note: 8 of 8 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.46). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, unresolved_rate=0.50, crash_risk=0.48.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Sampangiram Nagar' matched to datameet243=129 via exact_name (overlap_confidence=0.688).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Sampangiram Nagar for the period 2019–2022.
Request inspection records for the 33 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
Cross-reference crash location data with cluster centroid to assess whether road condition may be a contributing factor to road accidents.
